# ARCH-2: Test for what you need, not for what usually comes with it

- Code that needs a capability - a position, a healthy sensor, a link - tests for that capability directly, not for a proxy such as a failsafe having cleared. A proxy holds only until someone changes what it means.
- Where code acts on a proxy, ask what it actually needs and whether there is a direct test for it. [#34696](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/34696)'s restore needed a position and waited for the EKF failsafe to clear; once [#32514](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/32514) let the failsafe clear without a position, the restore was refused.

Confirmed 2026-10-13. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
